scope: TabM/BatchEnsemble-style rank-one multi-member feedforward classification MECHANISM, not official TabM implementation or TabReD reproduction
hypothesis: A small block-rotation m chart can encode useful native rank-one member diversity using less paid state; it must beat an equal-parameter source-independent deterministic linear role-code bank and native full member-specific rank-one fast weights in quality-per-byte, not merely a K-times full-network strawman.
teacher: binary labels from smooth nonlinear combination of 32d Gaussian features with within-world random invertible feature mixing; strength beta adds independently random higher-order features; all model methods share source data and parent initialization and see same labels. Not a TabM native benchmark.
model: shared 32→64 GELU→2 MLP with native per-member input r_in of length32 and hidden s_h length64. K predictions trained independently through same per-member loss averaged; ensemble evaluation averages softmax probabilities.
mirror: one learned 96d shared template fast-weight vector and K learned 4d angles; rotate all 48 adjacent 2D pairs with block angles from fixed 4x48 sign/frequency pattern; fast weights=1+0.1*rotated_template; template/angles paid. The rotation is a functional coordinate over fast weights, not a guarantee of superior model class.
linear_equal: learned template 96 plus Kx4 codes; fixed 4x96 orthonormal Hadamard decoder publicly reproducible from fixed seed (count seed/config); scales match Mirror. Separate learned dictionary full 4x96 control paid.
evaluation: ensemble test NLL/Brier/AUROC, member-specific CE, member prediction variance, calibration ECE, actual NPZ inferred-state bytes incl generator config and shared weights, CPU single-batch128 p50/p95 latency, trained MAC proxy and number of shared W GEMMs. Measure k=8 only stage0, later K4/16 only after new freeze.

gates.PASS: At least 4/5 fresh worlds (all beta families reported) Mirror role chart gains >=2% test NLL over equal-byte fixed-basis code while within +0.02 nat/example of native full fast weights, and stores at least 3% fewer whole-model bytes than native with <=1.10 native CPU P95. This is a mechanism only.
gates.FAIL: Native full or simple code dominates Mirror in task quality/storage/latency, or output members collapse with no ensemble benefit, or only a favorable aligned family passes.
gates.UNCERTAIN: single CPU tiny model, native TabM author source not reproduced, insufficient across-world support or clock variability; no natural TabReD or GPU claims.

checks: per-member fast weights genuinely change logits
manual packed and loop K members predictions equal
true serializer bytes not parameter proxies
native and Mirror share same input/targets/update counts, fixed seed head fair controls
hardware: PyTorch2.10+cpu, float32, 1 CPU thread, AMD EPYC9V74; fixed 20 warmups+100 repeats B128 for latency, no CUDA
policy: No auto change to registry status; experimental evidence is branch-isolated and original paper reproduction remains blocked.
